turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I dropped my camera in the sand at the beach. It sounds crunchy when I zoom. Please help.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: First, don't zoom or turn it on and off any more. Grinding sand gets in deeper every time the lens moves.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Use a blower brush, not your breath, on the lens barrel and the buttons. Hold the camera facing down so the grains fall out rather than in.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A soft clean makeup brush works for the outside. But if it still crunches after that, take it to a repair shop. Sand inside the zoom isn't a home job.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: A clean usually costs much less than a new lens. It's worth asking for a quote before you decide anything.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lesson learned. Camera bag next time.
